rules.title: Berkeley Annual General Adjustment capped at 5% (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: The yearly rent increase (Annual General Adjustment) for a fully covered Berkeley unit cannot be more than 5%, even if the CPI formula produces a higher number. Landlords with banked AGAs may still raise rent above 5% to reach the rent ceiling.
rules.requirement_es: El aumento anual de renta (Ajuste General Anual) para una unidad totalmente cubierta en Berkeley no puede ser mayor al 5%, aunque la fórmula del IPC dé un número más alto. Los propietarios con AGA acumulados aún pueden aumentar más del 5% para llegar al tope de renta.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully covered units under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.caveat: Measure BB passed November 2024; exact effective date not stated. Ordinance chapter cite inferred (Berkeley Rent Ordinance).

rules.title: Berkeley rent ceiling coverage of multifamily and subsidized units
rules.requirement: Most multifamily units built before 1980 are fully covered by Berkeley's rent ceiling. Government-owned or subsidized units are now registered as fully or partially covered depending on unit type and whether federal or state law bars rent control.
rules.requirement_es: La mayoría de las unidades multifamiliares construidas antes de 1980 están totalmente cubiertas por el tope de renta de Berkeley. Las unidades de propiedad gubernamental o subsidiadas ahora se registran como total o parcialmente cubiertas según el tipo de unidad y si la ley federal o estatal prohíbe el control de rentas.
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully covered: most multifamily units built before 1980; some single-family homes with tenancies begun before 1996; rooms rented individually in single-family homes with five or more rooms. Units with certificate of occupancy after 1980, most single-family homes and most condos are partially covered.
rules.exemptions: Units whose subsidies are barred from rent control by federal/state law (e.g., Section 202, Section 811, HUD-insured project-based) are only partially covered.
rules.caveat: Page says 'built before 1980' and 'certificate of occupancy issued after 1980'; cutoff date approximate.

rules.title: Berkeley just cause required for covered units
rules.requirement: Tenants in fully or partially covered Berkeley units cannot be evicted without just cause.
rules.requirement_es: Los inquilinos en unidades total o parcialmente cubiertas en Berkeley no pueden ser desalojados sin causa justificada.

rules.coverage_conditions: Fully or partially covered units under the Rent Ordinance.
rules.caveat: Measure BB changed some just causes; 'just cause' was previously 'good cause'.

rules.title: Nonpayment eviction requires debt of at least one month's Fair Market Rent
rules.requirement: A landlord can evict for nonpayment only if the tenant owes at least one month of HUD Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size (Oakland-Fremont metro FMR).
rules.requirement_es: Un propietario solo puede desalojar por falta de pago si el inquilino debe al menos un mes del alquiler justo de mercado (FMR) de HUD para una unidad de tamaño equivalente.
rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value
rules.caveat: FMR changes yearly with HUD fiscal year.

rules.title: No eviction for refusing to sign a new fixed-term lease
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for refusing to sign a substantially similar lease when a fixed-term lease expires.
rules.requirement_es: Un propietario no puede desalojar a un inquilino por negarse a firmar un contrato sustancialmente similar cuando vence un contrato de plazo fijo.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
